question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Detrimental
solution:
The correct answer is **'Harmless'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 Let's understand the meaning of the given words:

__
 
• Detrimental - Harmful, tending to cause harm.(हानिकारक, नुक़सानदेह)

 
 
• **Example**: Moving her could have a detrimental effect on her health.
 
 
 
• **Harmless -** not able or not likely to cause damage or injury.(हानिरहित, नुक़सान न देनेवाला)
 
 
• **Example: **These insects are completely** harmless.**
 
 

After seeing the above explanation, we can say that **'Harmless'** is the opposite word of **'Detrimental'**.

Hence, the correct answer is **option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 Let's understand the meaning of other given options:

 
• **Baseless - **not based on facts or good reasons; unfounded(बेबुनियाद, निराधार)
 
• **Senseless -** having no meaning or purpose.(बेमतलब, अर्थहीन, निरर्थक)
 
• **Meaningless - **without meaning, reason or sense.(बेमतलब, अर्थहीन)
